item.description:
# Shruti 1.4.4
- Shows only proven live audio, actively controlled rows, and a short 15-second recent-audio grace; running utilities and neutral SoundSource imports stay out of the mixer. - Suppresses Wispr Flow, Camo and ScreenFlow playback false positives caused by capture apps keeping a nominal Core Audio output stream warm while emitting no sound. - Adds persistent up/down ordering controls to every visible app, plus one-click Smart Order that restores the automatic playing-now-first layout. - Replaces the ambiguous green-dot treatment with an explicit LIVE waveform badge and labels short recent-audio grace rows by age, so a volume slider is never mistaken for a meter. - Keeps Google Chrome helper processes attributed to Chrome and preserves existing device order, routes, favorites, effects, locks and SoundSource-imported settings during the update.
